threads.body:
This bypasses the required implementation-local entry-program layer for programmatically configured telemetry. The scenario contract requires each such scenario to have an entry program beside `conformance.yaml` that imports the shared scenario; run that wrapper here (and expose the shared package through `PYTHONPATH`) while keeping the span processor registration on the launcher.

This issue also appears on line 28 of the same file.
threads.hunk:
@@ -0,0 +1,30 @@
+# Copyright The OpenTelemetry Authors
+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+
+runner: genai-conformance
+instrumented_library: agent-framework
+instrumentation_library: openinference-instrumentation-agent-framework
+
+server:
+  run: genai-mock-server --port ${PORT}
+
+env:
+  OPENAI_BASE_URL: ${MOCK_SERVER_URL}/v1
+  OPENAI_API_KEY: test_openai_api_key
+  # Agent Framework's own switch: instrumentation is on by default, message
+  # content is not.
+  ENABLE_SENSITIVE_DATA: "true"
+  # OpenInference records its own `llm.*` attributes by default;
+  # this is the switch that adds the GenAI conventions beside them.
+  OPENINFERENCE_ENABLE_GENAI_SEMCONV: "true"
+
+scenarios:
+  invoke_agent:
+    run: uv run --frozen --project . otel-conformance-python
+      --span-processor openinference.instrumentation.agent_framework:AgentFrameworkToOpenInferenceProcessor
+      ../scenarios/invoke_agent.py
